title: Cashew Crumble Bars
description: A sweet and nutty treat made with a shortbread crust, a cashew filling, and a crunchy crumble topping.
instructions: Prepare the flaky pastry crust by rolling it out into a square shape.
In a separate bowl, mix together the cashews, nutty granola, and maple syrup.
Spread the cashew mixture over the pastry crust, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Top the cashew mixture with the crumble topping.
Bake the bars for 25-30 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown and the filling is set.
Remove the bars from the oven and let them cool completely before slicing and serving.
